svg.title: IAMLab Slicer component map
svg.desc: All 25 components grouped into the main toolpath, review and analysis, Duet control, material calibration, and utilities. Original plugin icons are embedded.

g.text: Keep the layer tree intact from Slice through Place to Generator.
Generator gcode feeds these tools in parallel. Review before saving or running.
Use a shared machine profile and connection. Marlin and Klipper use exported files.
Plan runs, print consistent specimens, measure them, and choose a recipe.
Supporting tools for the machine and the Grasshopper document.
Follow the main path, then add review, analysis, machine control, or calibration.
Solid arrows: data connections. Dashed arrows: manual work or use of a result. Ribbon groups appear above each name.
Also share the bed and robot
Interlayer Time can also supply a legend.
Use the same Robot Definition for motion checks
SCARA calibration positions go to Machine Console. Retained job logs can be analysed in Interlayer Time.
Use Test Geometry to keep specimens consistent.
All 25 plugin components use their original icons.
Open the .drawio source to edit boxes, text, and arrows.
Connection labels show the value being passed. Consult the component reference for optional inputs and full wiring details.
